gates.command: poetry run pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/enterprise/ -W ignore::DeprecationWarning --cov --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml (codemie-pre-push chain, step 1)
gates.notes: The pre-push hook chains pytest then sonar-local; recorded separately because a chain aborts at its first failure. Equivalent run executed inside 'make sonar-local' above: 16869 passed, 172 skipped. The 'unit' gate ('make test') is a superset since it does not exclude tests/enterprise/. NOTE: the hook is configured in .pre-commit-config.yaml but not currently installed in .git/hooks (no non-sample hooks present), so it does not actually fire locally until 'make install-hooks' is run.

Guide: 'Skip if the user did not request coverage.' The verbatim target (HTML report) was not run, but 'make sonar-local' performed the equivalent XML coverage run at this HEAD and the server-side coverage condition passed. Enable locally with 'make coverage' if an HTML report is wanted.

Guide: 'Skip if you are not opening a merge request.' MR creation is out of scope for this runner.
